name: Schwoich
kurzbeschreibung: Charming residential community in the Inntal valley, boasting a picturesque location by Walchsee and the gardens of the Kaisergebirge.
beschreibung:
Schwoich lies at 620 metres above sea level at the southern foot of the Kaisergebirge, just a few kilometres west of Kufstein in the Tiroler Unterland. With around 2,600 inhabitants, the municipality is one of the quieter places in the Inntal – characterised by traditional farm architecture, expansive meadows and a village community spirit that is still palpable today.

The location directly at the foot of the Wilder and Zahmer Kaiser makes Schwoich an ideal starting point for hikes and climbing tours in the Naturpark Kaisergebirge. Along numerous marked trails, you can reach alpine pasture areas such as the Ritzau-Alm or the staffed Gasthof Kaiser Hochalm. Families appreciate the short, pushchair-friendly routes around the village, while sports enthusiasts use the cycle paths along the Inn and, in winter, the cross-country ski trails as well as ski touring opportunities in the mountains. The mild climate of the Inntal and the sheltered southern side of the Kaiser provide a comparatively high number of hours of sunshine.
